thread:
maria-finance: Heads up — UniLab invoice INV-2026-0924 (platform fee line) hit the customer today for full-year platform fee even though their Private deploy is paused for 4 months per their request. They signed renewal 2025-07-01 but lab closure started 2025-08-15 and they asked for prorated platform fee credit. Can we triage?

sam-csm: saw the ping. Customer's CSM updated their case but asked for a 50% credit for 4 months. Their committed support tier is Enterprise (S1) — they want to keep phone on-call but pause concurrency. They sent email with closure dates.

lior-sales: Sales agreed to a short-term pause in July renewal call? I thought we set renewal effective 2025-07-01 and platform fee is annual and non-refundable per contract section 3.2. We may offer goodwill credit but need legal ok.

oliver-legal: Contract clause 3.2 we can interpret to allow pro-rata in case of extended force majeure? Do we have documentation of the lab closure (customer mail)? Attachments on case: https://redwood.cases/CASE-1123

maria-finance: invoice snippet:
```
Platform fee (Private) — SKU: PLAT-PVT-ANNUAL
Qty: 1  Price: $60,000  Period: 2025-07-01 → 2026-06-30
Support (Enterprise S1) — SKU: SUP-ENT-ANNUAL
Qty: 1 Price: $18,500
Invoice total: $78,500
```
We need a recommended adjustment and an internal approval path.

sam-csm: customer asked for credit for Aug-Nov 2025 (4 months). Pro-rata for platform fee = (4/12)*60k = $20,000. They also asked to downgrade support to S0 for that period (S0 annual $9k) difference = $9,500 credit prorated = (4/12)*9,500 = ~$3,166. Total requested credit ~$23,166.

maria-finance: do we have precedent? Last year we did a one-off 25% goodwill credit for acme health (case 1857401234). Not identical.

lior-sales: I'd be okay with issuing a temporary credit if CSM secures exec alignment and we add a short addendum to renewal that pauses usage and preserves renewal date. Need legal to sign.

oliver-legal: OK, we can draft addendum that documents pause and confirms no extension to renewal term. But finance needs to ensure credit doesn't violate revenue recognition policies. @nate-ops / @eva-accounts to confirm accounting.

nate-ops: from ops side, when platform is paused we still have reserved capacity? For Private, customer hosts on-prem, so our platform fee is for product entitlement not capacity — pausing doesn't reduce cost. Ops: no additional infra savings.

eva-accounts: revenue recognition: any credit >$5k requires VP Finance approval and a journal entry. We need a memo. For ~$23k, we need sign-off from VP Finance (me) and CSM to confirm customer request and written consent.

maria-finance: proposed resolution:
- Issue pro-rata credit $23,166 on a credit memo
- Draft addendum signed by customer confirming pause Aug-Nov 2025, maintain renewal 2026-07-01, and downgrade support to S0 during pause period.
- Require exec approval (VP Finance + Sales lead)
- Return to customer with timeline 3-5 business days.

lior-sales: approved pending legal addendum. I'll escalate to my manager.

oliver-legal: drafting addendum now, will post draft in thread in 2 hours.

eva-accounts: approve provisionally pending signed addendum; send memo template to maria.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0924 sent to UniLab at 2025-07-15 09:12 UTC — status: delivered.

sam-csm: thx all. Maria, can you prepare credit memo draft and estimated GL impacts?

maria-finance: will do — I'll attach the credit memo and the memo for VP in this thread when ready.

lior-sales: ping me when doc's ready. I'll loop in sales lead.

oliver-legal: also need the customer's signed email thread. sam, please upload to case.

sam-csm: doing it now — uploaded.

maria-finance: update: credit memo drafted for $23,166 (rounded to $23,166.67). Memo for VP ready. Sending for approval.

eva-accounts: approved. Forward to VP for signature.

maria-finance: thanks — tagging @vp-finance for final sign-off.

vp-finance: signed. Proceed with credit memo issuance once we have signed addendum.

maria-finance: addendum received signed by customer. Issuing credit memo and applying to account. Will confirm when posted.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-004 applied to account UNI-LAB on 2025-08-03. Balance updated.

sam-csm: customer confirmed received credit and thanked. :tada: 

lior-sales: great work team. Closing this thread.
